critical_code_review_comments: Shared ChapterMarker component adoption is consistent across chapter pages and marker text/order is correct from CH. 01 to CH. 11.
Route direct hashes still settle deterministically to expected stops with data-traveling=false for all 11 routes.
Timeline interactions and Back to Circuit flow are functionally working; failures are placement/layout collisions, not navigation logic.
No runtime error banners found, no duplicate data-testid values detected in this run, and reduced-motion marker visibility passed for sampled chapters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated public URL chapter marker rollout against requested matrix. Core logic/order/routes pass, but placement regressions remain: desktop overlap (Gallery/Tracks title collisions) and recurring mobile Back to Circuit collisions; milestones marker clipping at 320x700 also present.
rca of the issue: RCA: marker positioning relies on fixed absolute top offsets (e.g., 80/108px patterns) while Back to Circuit has fixed top values and section title blocks vary by viewport/content density. On narrow/short screens these independent offsets converge, causing marker/button and marker/title intersections. Repro: navigate by #route-* across all chapters at 390x844 and 320x700, and Gallery/Tracks at desktop widths; observe bounding-box intersection between marker and required protected content.
